welcome.title: Welcome to {{brand}}
welcome.body: {{agent}} is your AI fitness and nutrition coach. This one-minute tour shows how the app works.

chat.title: Just talk to it
chat.body: Tell {{agent}} what you ate, how you trained or what you're aiming for, in your own words. Attach a photo of a plate or a nutrition label, or use the mic.

confirm.title: You confirm, it does the work
confirm.body: When the coach logs or changes something, it opens a form that's already filled in. Check it and tap Save. Nothing is saved without your OK.

screens.title: Your data, in four screens
screens.body: Everything the coach logs lands in these screens, and you can edit anything by hand. Let's take a quick look at each one.

day.title: Pick the day
day.body: Everything you log goes to the selected day. Tap here to look back or to log something for yesterday.

menu.title: Profile and settings
menu.body: Your profile sets your calorie and macro targets. This menu also has AI usage, calculators, the theme, and this tour if you want it again.

dashboard.title: Today at a glance
dashboard.body: Your calorie ring, macros, target vs eaten vs remaining, planned training, steps, water and calories burned. Use the arrows at the top to move between days.

foodLog.title: Food log
foodLog.body: Everything you ate on the selected day, meal by meal, with totals against your targets. Add food yourself or just tell the coach.

pantry.title: Pantry
pantry.body: Your own catalogue of foods and supplements, with macros, barcodes and what you have on hand. Scan a barcode, or import a receipt or grocery photo through the chat.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.body: Save recipes you make often, or import one from a link. Log a whole recipe, or just a few servings, as a meal in one go.

diet.title: Diet plans
diet.body: Multi-day meal plans with daily targets and a weekly schedule. Log a planned meal in one tap, or get a shopping list of what's missing from your pantry.

training.title: Training
training.body: Log your sessions: sets, reps, weight and effort, from a plan or freestyle. After you log, the coach suggests what to lift next time.

progress.title: Progress
progress.body: History for each exercise, estimated one-rep max and strength trends, so you can see yourself getting stronger.

plans.title: Workout plans
plans.body: Your training split: days, exercises and target sets, reps and weight. Build one here, ask the coach to make one, or upload the plan your trainer gave you.

bodyComposition.title: Body composition
bodyComposition.body: Weigh-ins and body fat, plus the numbers worked out from them: BMI, lean mass and FFMI. Trend charts show how they move over weeks or months.

bodyMeasurements.title: Measurements
bodyMeasurements.body: Log tape measurements of your shoulders, chest, arms, thighs and calves. A radar compares each one with the ideal for your frame and shows which muscles to focus on. You can also scan your shape with the camera.

finish.title: You're all set
finish.body: Start by filling in your profile (goal, height, weight and activity) so your targets fit you. Or just say hi to {{agent}}.
